beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, everybody goes out partying.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Every night, there's a party somewhere.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Pool parties.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Foam parties.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Even a birthday party for the mayor's pigeon.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My best friend Marcus goes to every party.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My neighbor Brenda goes to every party.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Even my grandad crowd-surfs on Wednesdays.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: But not me. I play chess.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Three hundred puzzles before breakfast.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I don't eat breakfast. I sacrifice it.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I castled my bed.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My cat only moves in L-shapes now.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Day by day.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then came the biggest party of the year.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The Summer Party Chess Match.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Everybody showed up in party hats.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: When I sat down, everybody laughed.

beats.speaker: heckler
beats.text: Who brings a chess clock to a party?

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My opponent? The mayor. Undefeated for forty years.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then I touched my first pawn.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Checkmate. In four moves.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The music stopped. The whole crowd went silent.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Marcus asked me,

beats.speaker: marcus
beats.text: When did you get so good?

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I told him the truth.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: While you were out partying.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The next night, something was wrong.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: No music. No party lights. Nothing.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then I heard it. From every single window.

beats.speaker: town
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Marcus was playing chess.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Brenda was playing chess.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My grandad was playing blindfolded.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: He just lost his glasses.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The whole town is grinding now. Which is great.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except now, nobody has time to play me.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: So my only opponent is the mayor's pigeon.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: He knocks over all the pieces, struts around the board...

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: and honestly? I think he's winning.

beats.speaker: pigeon
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
